latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Editing AI Link — edit and export videos with AI in minutes.

- Upload raw footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and describe your edits to get an automatically edited video.
- AI handles cutting pauses, adding transitions, and exporting clean MP4s quickly with no editing software needed.
- Easy token-based connection — automatically acquires a free token if needed.
- Supports viewing credits, session state, uploading files, exporting, and batch workflows.
- Clear error handling, status updates, and tips for best results included.
